messages.subject: Getting metadata, latitude|longitude from matR
parts:
Hi, 

I have been using a R script using (matR) to get latitude and longitude data for lists of MG-RAST id's. The MGRAST metaserver was down today and now it is back up and I can't get the script to work. I can download the biom files, but the second step is not converting the file and the third step is not getting the latitude/longitude metadata.

library (matR)
#1
mbnA <- biomRequest ("mgm4447016.3, mgm4447020.3, mgm4447101.3, mgm4461363.3, mgm4461364.3, mgm4461365.3, mgm4461366.3, mgm4461367.3, mgm4461368.3, mgm4472090.3, mgm4472091.3, mgm4472094.3, mgm4472095.3, mgm4472096.3, mgm4472098.3, mgm4472100.3, mgm4472102.3, mgm4472105.3, mgm4472138.3, mgm4472139.3, mgm4472140.3, mgm4472142.3, mgm4472162.3, mgm4472164.3, mgm4472171.3", request="function")
#2
mbnA1 <- transform (mbnA, t_Threshold, t_Log)
#3
mbnA2 <- columns (mbnA1, "latitude|longitude")

Do you have any thoughts of what might be going wrong now? Thanks.

Sincerely, Michaeline
